doc: A shrub species: a light version of a tree genome (design/systems.md, Shrubs and ground cover), grown from several stems at the ground. Genomes are data (the workspace's config/bush_genomes/).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Display name, e.g. Hazel.

fields.name: latin
fields.doc: Botanical name, for reference.

fields.name: deciduous
fields.doc: Drops its leaves for winter.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Height of a mature shrub in the game, metres.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: Spread over height.

fields.name: age_height
fields.doc: Height of a young, mature, and old shrub, as fractions of the mature height (3 values).

fields.name: shape
fields.doc: Outline: round (a dome), upright (a vase of straight canes), spreading (low and wide), or fan (stalked fan leaves from the ground, as on a palmetto).

fields.name: stems
fields.doc: Stems from the ground.

fields.name: stem_spread
fields.doc: How far the outer stems lean out, radians.

fields.name: stem_curve
fields.doc: Bend along a stem, radians: positive arches out and over (a fountain), negative stiffens upward.

fields.name: branches
fields.doc: Side branches per stem.

fields.name: branch_angle
fields.doc: Side branch angle from its stem, degrees.

fields.name: branch_length
fields.doc: Side branch length over its stem's.

fields.name: twigs
fields.doc: Twigs per side branch.

fields.name: wobble
fields.doc: Crookedness: random turn per segment, radians.

fields.name: foliage
fields.doc: How foliage is built: broadleaf clumps, needle tufts, or fans (palmate leaves on long stalks).

fields.name: clump
fields.doc: Foliage clump radius over mature height.

fields.name: leafiness
fields.doc: Foliage clumps per branch region; 1 is a normal shrub.

fields.name: leaf_spring
fields.doc: Leaf colour in spring, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: leaf_summer
fields.doc: Leaf colour in summer, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: leaf_fall
fields.doc: Leaf colour in fall, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: leaf_fall_alt
fields.doc: Second fall colour, mixed in per clump, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: leaf_winter
fields.doc: An evergreen's winter leaf colour, or a deciduous shrub's last dead leaves, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: fall_drop
fields.doc: Share of leaves already fallen in fall.

fields.name: winter_keep
fields.doc: Share of dead leaves a deciduous shrub keeps through winter.

fields.name: bloom
fields.doc: Share of foliage clumps in flower per season (winter, spring, summer, fall; 4 values).

fields.name: blossom_color
fields.doc: Flower colour, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: blossom_size
fields.doc: Flower clusters' size over the foliage clump's.

fields.name: fruit
fields.doc: Berry clusters per foliage clump in fruit (0 = none).

fields.name: fruit_size
fields.doc: Berry radius, metres (style.md section 3 wants it chunky).

fields.name: fruit_cluster
fields.doc: Berries per cluster.

fields.name: fruit_seasons
fields.doc: How far ripe the fruit is per season (winter, spring, summer, fall; 4 values): 0 none, between 0 and 1 unripe to ripe.

fields.name: fruit_unripe
fields.doc: Unripe berry colour, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: fruit_ripe
fields.doc: Ripe berry colour, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: pickable
fields.doc: Its berries or nuts can be picked: the pipeline's fruit parameter applies, and the game can offer picking. Otherwise the parameter is disabled and whatever it bears (seed balls, capsules) stays on.

fields.name: bark_light
fields.doc: Bark colour on ridges, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: bark_dark
fields.doc: Bark colour in furrows, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: snow
fields.doc: How much snow settles on it in winter.

fields.name: flex
fields.doc: Wind flexibility.
